cards.title: Model Joy for Your Children After Hardship
cards.body: Focus on cultivating feelings of enjoyment rather than just activities, writes advice columnist Eleanor Gordon-Smith. Making room for joy is also making room for your authentic self.

cards.title: How Kids Challenged My Musical Snobbery
cards.body: A father discovers his children have better musical taste than he expected. While music may not define them as it did his generation, they still recognize quality.

cards.title: Stop Being a 'Mumsy' Snob—Respect Mothers
cards.body: The term 'mumsy' carries contempt, reducing motherhood to something drab and old-fashioned. Why can't we show respect for mothers instead of deriding them?

cards.title: Fathers Must Step Up on Diaper Duty
cards.body: Basketball star LaMelo Ball proudly avoids changing diapers, but avoiding parental responsibility is outdated. Modern fathers should share all aspects of childcare equally.

cards.title: Stop Snowplow Parenting Now
cards.body: Removing all obstacles from your child's path disrupts their healthy development. Children need support balanced with independence to build crucial life skills.

cards.title: Help Anxious Teens Manage Their Worries
cards.body: If your child is more anxious lately, model calm and reassurance in your own behavior. These three guideposts can help you both manage worry effectively.

cards.title: Reading Boosts Your Child's Emotional Intelligence
cards.body: Reading with your child strengthens early literacy skills and emotional understanding. This simple practice helps them develop crucial social-emotional capabilities.

cards.title: Help Stressed Teens During College Season
cards.body: Two therapists discovered their stressed teen needed listening, not more advice. Asking one thoughtful question and truly hearing the response helped most.

cards.title: Childminder Jailed for Leaving Children Alone
cards.body: Amanda Mathewson was convicted of neglecting more than 20 children left unattended at her Dunfermline home. Parents discovered the abuse through hidden camera surveillance.
